items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: a Chinese doctor sewed me up. Everybody in that hospital come to see that job. He did a beautiful job.

ctx.x: What was your sort of mental attitude (inaudible) at this time?

Well, you know, after I told you I went in for my second operation, and I was better then, and I was running into this (inaudible) nothing bothered me anymore. Our anniversary was the 29th of April, and we had talked about and discussed what we were going to do on our anniversary, where we were going to be. I said, 'We'll discuss it.'

So we had the accident on April 23rd. There wasn't no discussion. We knew where we were then, in the hospital. Friends came up from New York to visit us on our anniversary, and I'm…
Arnett, did that bother your embouchure? (inaudible). Got all that strength back? Well, he did do a good job.
